verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs describe agents running scripts directly against a user's live Anytype data/vault (anytype-docs-5, anytype-docs-37) via the local API, but there is no mention of a separate sandbox, staging space, or test environment where such scripts could be run without touching the user's actual production vault/data. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/test space or environment, isolation guarantees for agent script testing, any documentation of a 'test mode' distinct from production data.
